frozen: 2026-10-10, before any swap bank, field, ground truth or result exists. The pair rule, the bank, the ground-truth thresholds and the criterion are not changed after a validation run; the concrete pairs are resolved from labels and text only (scripts/make_swap_bank.py) and recorded in each bank and its run record.
purpose: Replica semantic swap (usplat/swap.py): in the update pass, the features of source-class pixels are replaced by real features of a target class of the same scene. Synthetic, labelled supporting evidence for the change test and the reset; RIO10 is the real benchmark.
downscale_note: the accumulation grid of the Tab I fields (scripts/replica_tab1.sh DOWNSCALE=2); bank, run and ground truth use it

pair_rule.excluded_note: structure and surfaces fixed to the building: never a source or a target
pair_rule.kinds_note: the source with the most update pixels gets its NEAREST class in text space (hard case), the second its FARTHEST (easy case); text = extractor text embeddings with the frozen templates_by_extractor of the vocabulary, cosine; ties: lower class id
pair_rule.ranking: sources by update pixels (desc), ties lower class id

bank.note: segments from every frame_step-th mapping frame (Sequence_1, stride 5); one 8-connected component of the target class per segment; features before the PCA (projected by the run's own PCA)

gt.note: share of a Gaussian's update-pass splat mass on swapped pixels: swapped >= 0.5, static <= 0.05, else unjudged; total update mass below 1 pixel (accumulation grid) is unobserved

eval.query_classes: the classes with labelled pixels in the scene's mapping or update frames (the bank's classes), vocabulary order
eval.ours_noreset: the same run with --field-config '{"change_test": false}' and the reset field's PCA (--pca-from)

criterion.statement: ours with reset has a higher accuracy on swapped Gaussians than ours without reset and than averaging, at a static reset mass <= 1%, on >= 5 of the 6 test scenes
